name: printops-readonly
description: Example descriptor for dsh alpha.1; the copyable profile files live under profile.example/.
operationalNotes: This file is an example, not an auto-loaded dsh profile.

The session placeholder must be replaced by a trusted host before process creation; dsh passes argv without shell interpolation. The YAML template uses a dsh-evaluated JS expression for this non-secret session value.
Use the launcher with an explicit session id. Never add --allow-any-session.
L1 tools and any external side effects remain disabled for the first smoke.
